summary: NordFrame Logistics requires a centralized web-based inventory dashboard to provide real-time visibility across 6 regional warehouses in Germany and Austria. The solution must integrate with their existing PostgreSQL database, incorporate role-based access control, and follow a phased rollout starting with a 3-month pilot.
budget: €80,000–€120,000 total, including first year of support
timeline: Working pilot at one warehouse within 3 months; full rollout to all 6 sites within 6 months

criteria.title: Web-based real-time inventory dashboard
criteria.description: A web-based dashboard showing real-time inventory levels across all 6 warehouses.
criteria.rationale: This is the primary deliverable and foundational core of the entire RFP; without it, the project's main goal cannot be achieved.

criteria.title: PostgreSQL database integration
criteria.description: Integration with existing PostgreSQL inventory database with no migration to a new database.
criteria.rationale: Mandatory technical constraint as the client explicitly prohibits database migration, requiring direct integration with the legacy database.

criteria.title: Role-based access control (RBAC)
criteria.description: Role-based access where warehouse managers only see their own site and HQ staff see all sites.
criteria.rationale: Essential security and organizational requirement to enforce data boundaries and ensure proper operational governance.

criteria.title: Automated low-stock alerts
criteria.description: Automated low-stock alerts sent to warehouse managers when items fall below a configurable threshold.
criteria.rationale: Crucial for operational success and proactive inventory management, preventing stockouts across regional sites.

criteria.title: Data migration and onboarding plan
criteria.description: A data migration / onboarding plan for rolling this out across all 6 sites with minimal disruption.
criteria.rationale: High business value required to ensure operational continuity during the phased rollout from pilot to full deployment.

criteria.title: Support and maintenance terms
criteria.description: Support and maintenance terms after go-live, including response times and SLAs.
criteria.rationale: Crucial for post-launch operational stability, given that inventory decisions will rely heavily on this system.

criteria.title: Documentation of assumptions, limitations, and risks
criteria.description: Clear documentation of any assumptions, limitations, or risks, since inventory decisions will be made based on this system.
criteria.rationale: Standard expected practice for risk management and decision-making transparency, enhancing project reliability.
